## Natives of the exes

### STA_IsEnabled

    STA_IsEnabled((any, ignored))

returns int 0; answers at once; in AP+FL; number AP 41, FL 40; handler `0x00407089` (AP), `0x0047b71e` (FL); confidence high.

**Stub (no Steam layer in this exe): meant to give whether the Steam/community layer is enabled; always answers int 0.**

Handled inside the X2 dispatcher (STA natives are X2 group numbers 41, FL 40). The case reads no argument and answers int 0 at once (ResumeTaskWithIntVm); nothing else happens. The Steam/achievement/stat/DLC/DID back end of the X3 Steam builds is not present in X3AP.exe or X3FL.exe, so scripts must treat every STA_ answer as "not available".

- **FL:** same (FL dispatcher index 40)
- **x3_src:** same
